text_block_list.text:
The day of the academy student exchange 
event. The venue was bustling with many 
students.

And what made this exchange event 
different from usual... was that Tracen 
Academy graduates had been invited.

text_block_list.name: Academy Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
N-Nice to meet you! I've always admired 
your races... I always wanted to meet you 
one day...!

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Senior
text_block_list.text: Hey, Rudolf! Long time no see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ! It has been a long time, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Senior
text_block_list.text:
A precious exchange of opinions between 
alumni and current students... It's such a 
fruitful initiative, so very like you. As 
expected of the Student Council President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The experiences I shared with our 
seniors have become my sustenance, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, working together with 
you on preparations... was for an exchange 
event, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have been appointed to supervise the 
exchange event executive committee. My 
name is Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, glad to have you! But wow, you're 
the supervisor even though you're not on 
the student council. That really shows how 
much your abilities are recognized.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is the greatest honor. ...I will never 
let this opportunity granted by my seniors 
go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will ensure that this exchange event 
becomes an inspiring experience for all 
students.

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
How does this look? The proposal for the 
event activity. I was thinking we could do 
a bingo tournament again this time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am sure everyone will enjoy it. 
...That being said, may I add an element 
of racing to it?

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you want to adjust it further? I 
don't mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I will not increase Senpai's 
burden. Please, allow me to handle it 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
We plan to borrow the cafeteria as the 
venue. We thought we'd just let 
participants sit wherever they like.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for making the arrangements. 
However, would it be permissible if I 
proposed the seating arrangement?

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
The seating? I'm not opposed, but... 
Wouldn't that just add more work for 
you...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is an opportunity for students to 
gain racing insights. To make it an even 
better occasion, please permit me this 
indulgence.

—Even after that, Symboli Rudolf continued 
to take on more work. Eventually—

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rudolf. Hasn't your workload become 
way too enormous lately? Everyone around 
you is worried.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... My apologies. To think I caused 
my seniors undue worry.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, I am sorry for 
the trouble, but could I have a moment to 
speak to the executive committee members?

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Senior
text_block_list.text: Hey, Rudolf. Everyone's gathered here...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for taking the time to gather. 
Today, there is something I wish to share 
with you all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It concerns this event where students 
foster mutual connections— specifically, 
its true significance.

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
Huh... significance...? ...Isn't it just a 
regular school event...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As supervisor, this is what I believe. 
This exchange event could serve as an 
impetus for students to embrace hope.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In this world, there are many horse girls 
who leave the racing scene midway through 
their ambitions. ...However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If their seniors offer them words of 
encouragement... If their juniors look up 
to them with eyes of admiration...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There must surely be horse girls who find 
hope and rise back up from their setbacks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I want to make this 
exchange event the best it can possibly 
be.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of bringing happiness to as 
many horse girls as possible.

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...! Is that why you took on that huge 
mountain of work alone...?

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um! When my friend had to quit the 
academy, I was so sad too...! Isn't there 
more I can do to help...?!
(murmur, murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Senior
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible... It's as if everyone's 
being guided by her...!

text_block_list.name: Rudolf's Senior
text_block_list.text:
That exchange event you held with such 
noble aspirations was a massive success. 
...Everyone's eyes were shining so 
brightly back then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Even now, I have never forgotten 
that sight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Carrying out one's original intention—the 
ideal I must fulfill remains unshakeable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu...
choice_data_list:
Your convictions haven't changed since 
long ago.

Your convictions haven't changed since 
long ago.
You are the pride of Tracen Academy!
You are the pride of Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, naturally.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To guide every horse girl to happiness. 
That is my mission, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. However, that ideal is still 
only halfway realized.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall continue to devote myself. ...With 
unwavering singleness of purpose.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ufu♪ That's our Student Council President, 
our pride and joy, alright!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You know, there's a junior here who's 
dying to meet you! ...It seems she really 
wanted to chat with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Maruzensky. Then let us 
speak. So that my words may be engraved 
upon that junior's heart.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am honored. ...In that case, I shall 
continue to exert myself for the sake of 
all horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Officer
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! President! Regarding the invited 
graduates, it seems some haven't arrived 
yet...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I will attend to it 
immediately. ...Pardon me, I must take my 
leave. I must fulfill my duties as Student 
Council President.
